title: An agentic document reader: search, read, finish under a fixed budget, against a same-session B1 control

population.name: held-out-14 (development data since E7)
population.note: the MMLongBench-Doc test pool is used up (final evaluation, 2026-11-26) and is not touched

arms.B1s: B1, requests byte-identical to frozen E8 L-B1 (same-session control)
arms.AGb: the agent, replicate 2 (identical requests at the first call)

reader.images: 768-px short side, the archived E5 renders, detail high

agent.warm_start: the first message holds B1's exact top 4 ColQwen2 pages (frozen E5 ranking)

tools.search_pages: query -> top 8 page numbers by ColQwen2 MaxSim over all pages, relative scores, no images
tools.read_pages: up to 4 page images, each preceded by [Page N]; images in a user message after the tool message
tools.finish: B1's strict schema {answer, cited_pages, evidence[{page, quote}]}

limits.tool_choice: required; finish forced on the last call

guards: repeated query (case and spacing normalised) refused
invalid JSON arguments, unknown tool or no tool call cost the step
invalid finish rejected and may be fixed; on the forced call it is kept as a schema failure

search_encoder.device: Datalab CPU, torch 2.15.0+cpu, transformers 5.23.0, bf16, 8 threads
search_encoder.new_condition: E5 encoded queries on Apple MPS; CPU query embeddings are not bitwise equal

parity_gate.rule: top-4 set equal to frozen E5 for >= 90 % of the 118 questions and |recall@4 CPU - E5| <= 0.02

plans.smoke: 6 agent episodes on development questions, not scored
plans.full: 118 blocks (one per question, seeded order) of B1s, AGa, AGb; the 6 arm orders balanced across blocks

budget.note: the worst case (every episode using 6 calls and 12 pages) is below the ceiling; every call's upper bound is also checked against the remaining ceiling before it is sent (fail-closed)

metrics.primary: AG - B1s, S-v1 correct (score > 0) on the 102 answerable questions, AG = mean of AGa and AGb per question
secondary: H2 mechanism: evidence recall of the pages seen, AG vs B1s top 4 (101 labelled questions)
H3: the contrast within the 39 questions whose evidence is incomplete in the top 4, and outside them
accuracy by number of evidence pages (1, 2-3, 4+), descriptive
correct abstentions (16), citation validity (cited pages within pages seen), schema validity
calls, searches, reads, pages seen, prompt tokens (cached and not), cost, latency per question
AGa vs AGb flips; B1s vs frozen E8 L-B1 and E9 B1s drift
S-v2 with owner labels reused for identical blind items; new gray items queued, never model-judged
metrics.statistics: document-cluster percentile bootstrap (10,000 draws) and exact document sign-flip test (2^14 patterns), as E9

decision_rules_in_order: regression if a guardrail fails (each agent replicate: correct abstentions >= B1s - 2, citation validity >= 0.99, schema validity >= 0.99) or delta <= -0.05
no_meaningful_gain unless delta >= +0.05 on average and in each replicate
regression if broken > fixed / 2 in either replicate
gain_without_mechanism unless the evidence-recall contrast is > 0 with bootstrap 5th percentile > 0
too_expensive if the mean observed agent cost exceeds $0.01 per question
go if bootstrap 5th percentile > 0, sign-flip p <= 0.05 and AGa vs AGb flips <= 10
interpretation_limits: development data: the 118 questions shaped E7-E9; a go here leads to a confirmatory test on a new benchmark, not a claim
an honest gain of 3-5 questions is within replicate noise on 102 questions
one reader alias without a snapshot; results are defined by the frozen replies
